Date confirmed (Saturday October 3rd), arrival window confirmed (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), addresses confirmed (both pickup locations and destination), but phone number NOT confirmed, crew size NOT confirmed (rep mentions 'one truck lift' but never specifies number of movers), and NO notes left for crew about customer concerns (there were none raised, but no attempt to document any logistics considerations).

top_strength: Jevic gathered all essential logistics details methodically across two pickup locations and one destination, correctly handled the complex multi-stop scenario, and delivered clear pricing framing with no hidden fees and the full Two Promises package.
coaching_note: The biggest gap is Section 2: never ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into logistics — this opens the call strategically and earns trust; instead, you skipped straight to probing and left the customer's real agenda unheard.
